title: Integral finite-basis cohomology and Kummer exactness
statement: Let $C$ be a scheme, $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site, $L$ an integral module with a basis $b_j$ indexed by $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$, and $q\geq0$. Using cohomology from [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there is an additive equivalence $\alpha:H^q(C,G)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}L\simeq H^q(C,\bigoplus_j G)$ satisfying $\alpha(x\otimes l)=H^q(\sum_j b_j^*(l)\iota_j)(x)$. Also, for $m\in\mathbf N$ invertible on $C$, the maps $\bigoplus_j\mu_m\to\bigoplus_j\mathbf G_m\to\bigoplus_j\mathbf G_m$ obtained from the ordinary Kummer sequence [def-sc-kummer-sequence] are a short exact complex. These statements include $r=0$.

source.place: Finite-direct-sum argument; integral-lift interpretation in the parent node. Stacks Tags 015B, 03EK and 03PL.

proof.text: Define the cohomology tensor comparison using equivFinsuppOfBasisRight and the sum of the cohomology inclusions. Its inverse is the sum of the cohomology projections tensored with basis vectors. Additivity of Sheaf.functorH and the biproduct identities show both composites are identities. The basis expansion gives the normalized formula, including rank zero.

The finite constant-diagram limit functor is exact in the abelian sheaf category. Map the ordinary short exact Kummer sequence through it and transport across biproduct.isoProduct and Pi.isoLimit. Naturality of these isomorphisms identifies both arrows with biproduct.map.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_cohomology_biproduct (C : Scheme.{u})
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (L : ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) (r : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) ℤ L)
    [HasBiproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ G)] (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ alpha : (Sheaf.H G q ⊗[ℤ] L) ≃+ Sheaf.H (⨁ fun _ : Fin r ↦ G) q,
      ∀ (x : Sheaf.H G q) (l : L), alpha (x ⊗ₜ[ℤ] l) =
        Sheaf.H.map (∑ j : Fin r, (b.repr l j) •
          biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r ↦ G) j) q x
